div.div: عَكْمَةٌ A corner of the belly: (K:) pl. عَكُومٌ. (TA.) Some restrict it to negative phrases: they say, مَا بَقِىَ فِى بَطْنِ الدَّابَّةِ هَزْمَةٌ وَلَا عَكْمَةٌ إِلَّا ٱمْتَلَأَتْ [There remained not in the belly of the beast a depression nor a corner but it became full]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
